recipe.title: Banana pikelets
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Nadia Lim's book, 'Yum!'
recipe.serves: Makes six pikelets or two pancakes. Multiply by the number of people.

method.s: Mash banana well with a fork until there are no lumps.
Whisk in egg, flour and baking powder.
Cook in a lightly buttered pan for 1-2 minutes each side. Flip when bubbles start appearing on the surface.
